scope: strictly additive: new module src/owned_path.rs + pub use in lib.rs + tests/owned_path.rs; no existing file body changed

commits.summary: Nib: additive owned serializable path geometry
owned path tests; to_kurbo validates first

Nib: exact canonical float encoding within the element budget (exponent form beyond 24 bytes), is_closed shares validate's subpath state machine; round-trip property test, exhaustive is_closed/validate equivalence (R3 remediation)

capabilities_done: OwnedPath { elements: Vec<PathElement>, fill_rule: FillRule } with PathElement MoveTo/LineTo/QuadTo/CubicTo/Close over f64 PathPoint; FillRule NonZero/EvenOdd (TryFrom<Winding>, Winding::None refused)

validate(&PathLimits): finite and |v| <= 1e9, element budget, must start with MoveTo, no drawing after Close without MoveTo, Close needs drawn segment, optional require_closed per subpath; is_closed()
to_kurbo()/from_kurbo() lossless, to_kurbo validates first (kurbo debug-asserts on a missing MoveTo)
from_anchors(anchors, closed, winding, unit, ppi, limits): relative handles, unit conversion via accord Length::convert, implicit straight close
to_canonical_json() / strict from_canonical_json() / content_sha256(): deterministic text, -0 normalised, shortest round-trip decimals, no unknown or duplicate fields, bounded input

tests.regression: full nib suite green: 3 unit + 5 owned_path + 2 path_boolean; clippy clean for nib; cargo check --tests green for the only dependents render-cpu and interop-vector
tests.tree: shared edit tree; nib has no uncommitted changes at 07abf54

decisions_for_lead: NO serde in nib: nib has no serde dependency and hand-rolls its strict encodings, so adding serde (plus its proc-macro closure) would have turned a validated crate's registry/probe pins red until the steward syncs. Serialization is canonical JSON text + SHA-256 (sha2 already a nib dependency); consumers that need serde Serialize wrap the canonical text (render-cpu does).
Coordinates are unit-agnostic f64; from_anchors takes the target unit explicitly. Handles are anchor-relative vectors (nib descriptor 'zero relative pt vectors').
cause_of_failed_run: test fixture bug (an escape sequence in a strictness fixture was written as a plain character, so the fixture text was valid JSON); fixed in df2c896. The gameplan retry-guard was satisfied by a HEAD change, not bypassed.
next: Independent validator round on df2c896; render-cpu consumes OwnedPath since f105552.

verdicts.remediation: Emit shortest round-trip exponent form (or budget >=330 B/number); is_closed treats MoveTo as opening a subpath; tests

fixed.cause: f64 Display already yields shortest round-trip digits but never switches to an exponent, so 5e-324 is written as ~326 bytes against the 160 B/element budget and from_canonical_json refused its own output
fixed.fix: write_number: plain Display text while <= 24 bytes (every ordinary value, so existing canonical text and content hashes are unchanged), else LowerExp ({:e}, shortest round-trip, <= 24 bytes); const assert 4 + 6*(1+24) + 2 <= ELEMENT_BUDGET_BYTES (160) so every valid path fits max_input_bytes
fixed.regression_test: canonical_json_round_trips_every_valid_path_within_budget: [MoveTo(5e-324,-5e-324)] at max_elements=1, 17-digit e-300 worst case at full budget, plain-text pin for ordinary values, 400-case deterministic xorshift property (subnormals to 1e9, all element kinds): bit-exact round trip, canonical-text fixed point, equal sha, len <= max_input_bytes

fixed.fix: validate and is_closed share one subpath state machine (check_structure); is_closed = non-empty and check_structure(require_closed, no coordinate check) is Ok, so [M], [M,L,Z,M] and [M,Z] are not closed
fixed.regression_test: is_closed_agrees_with_require_closed_validation: named cases plus exhaustive equivalence with validate(require_closed) over all 97656 verb sequences up to length 7

r3_remediation.red_proof: static: old writer emitted ~696 B for the 5e-324 path vs 416 B budget; old is_closed returned true for [M] and [M,L,Z,M]. Not executed against old code in the nib lane (shared tree).

owned_path.rs:323 'strict inverse' doc wording vs tolerant reader
